provenancePolicy: External claims remain candidate observations until source URLs, publication timestamps, and source snapshots are attached by the collector.

observations.observation: High-value engineering agents are increasingly framed around generation plus formal verification, defect localization, and human approval rather than generation alone.
observations.recommendedExperiment: Require every generated artifact to declare constraints, validators, repair attempts, approval state, and evidence receipt.

observations.observation: Output volume is an insufficient proxy for AI-assisted engineering value; accepted outcomes, rework, defects, review burden, maintenance cost, and infrastructure cost form a stronger measurement set.
observations.recommendedExperiment: Add a PR evidence scorecard that records verified outcome, regression count, reviewer minutes, and repeatability.

observations.observation: Ecological interventions become more actionable when crop and climate context, intervention method, field protocol, ecological impact, operational cost, and adoption barriers are evaluated together.
observations.recommendedExperiment: Model fabrication and regenerative interventions with the same context-intervention-measurement-adoption evidence envelope.

observations.observation: A comparatively inexpensive sensor can unlock high-value system performance when paired with a calibrated inference model and corrective feedback loop.
observations.recommendedExperiment: Treat browser telemetry and fabrication measurements as sensors feeding deterministic correction and acceptance gates.

observations.observation: Everyday operational traces can reveal how a system reproduces itself more clearly than monumental outputs alone.
observations.recommendedExperiment: Preserve routine runs, failures, repairs, decisions, and acceptance receipts alongside polished portfolio artifacts.
